title: The Saint of the Open Hand | Nat 20 Pixels C1E7
description:
Home to Brindle Cross, with three dead lantern-cores and no lit lantern.
An old priest has two stories to tell tonight. One of them is Oriel's.

Episode 7 of a daily pixel-art D&D 5e story. Brannoc, Ilsevel, Tamsin and Oriel return to the Crooked Kettle, where Father Tobin tells the tale of Saint Wenna by the hearth, and of the frost night he found a baby at the foot of the oldest lantern on the road. Then the door bangs open. Every roll is decided by real, seeded dice shown on screen.

New episode every weekday. Characters, quotes and every roll are on the wiki.
